newsitem.title: FINLAND: MIXED HELSINKI ENDS ALMOST FLAT AS NOKIA RECOVERS.
newsitem.headline: MIXED HELSINKI ENDS ALMOST FLAT AS NOKIA RECOVERS.

text.p: * Shares close a shade lower on Monday with Nokia paring losses to end off two markka at 469.00 after a brief attempt in positive ground on the firmer dollar, brokers say.
* Nokia's fall to a 461 session low dragged stocks earlier.
* Market mixed as dollar-sensitive cyclical stocks gain and interest-rate sensitive issues suffer, they said.
* Eyes on Buba on Tuesday, H1 results and U.S. data Wednesday.
* Volume 700 million markka, 66 pct in Nokia, adv-decl 18-58

Shares closed almost flat at the main indices on Monday as the dollar turned higher in the European afternoon, boosting cyclical stocks and taking Nokia off its earlier lows which had dragged others, brokers said.
"This was quite a special market today, cyclicals gained and others were not in too good shape," one broker said.
The HEX general index closed down 0.25 percent at 3,600.54 after dipping to 3,569.7 earlier, and the FOX derivatives and portfolio benchmark closed up 0.02 percent at 1,235.6 points.
Brokers said volume was relatively lively at 730 million markka despite uncertaintly this week caused by U.S. data.
There was also uncertainty about German Bundesbank's fixed rate weekly repo tender on Tuesday amid speculation that Buba may move to a variable rate and let rates drift higher.
"Nervousness can continue as we watch what Buba will do tomorrow," said one broker.
The ongoing study on a merger of state-controlled energy groups Neste and IVO fuelled merger speculation, and Neste rose 7.00 markka or over five percent to 144.00, brokers said.
Finland's leading banking group Merita fell 0.60 markka to 22.90 on interest rate jitters and on profit-taking ahead of its H1 report due early on Wednesday, they said.
